---
title: "RPS: Rental Property Schedule"
description: "Information about rental property income and expenses for individuals, trusts and partnerships."
---

Information about rental property income and expenses for individuals, trusts and partnerships.

*Explains rental income, expenses, deductions and the records reported through tax returns.*
